_about: A330-900, from Airbus AC A330 (Dec 01/25) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-900 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 64) and 2 (plan: page index 65). Pixels of layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill rasters, line centres: the side at scale 16 turned level (--rotate -0.46), the plan at 15.147 (the side sheet's 81.56 px a meter). The A330-300's fuselage, fin and tailplane points lie on these sheets (moved a few px) and are snapped; the A330neo's nacelles, longer wing and sharklets are placed here. Scaled by the printed 63.66 m overall length from the nose to the tail cone. Windows behind the wing's lines and a dimension line at the drawing's pitch; door 3's height is the A330-300's.

sources.title: Airbus, A330 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Dec 01/25), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-900 sheets 1 and 2
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a339/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The fuselage, fin and tailplane points are the A330-300's, which lie on this sheet; the nacelles, wing tips and sharklets are traced here. The side view is turned level from the sheet's ground attitude (0.46°). Engine out from the centerline: half the printed 18.74 m between the engines.
